metadata.description: OpZero products for research, community, writing, and software.

plugins.name: agent-samaritan-ministry
plugins.description: Find a church community, reach a pastoral care team, volunteer locally, or find a ministry that can help with a practical need.

plugins.name: agent-samaritan-recovery
plugins.description: Find a peer recovery meeting that fits your day, check the access details, or find support for someone close to you.

plugins.name: bible-study
plugins.description: Read a passage in the Berean Standard Bible or King James Version, explore a Greek or Hebrew word, and keep your own notes beside the text.

plugins.name: sermon-prep
plugins.description: Build a sermon from the passage outward, with parallel translations, original-language notes, early Christian sources and a private place for the manuscript.

plugins.name: sacred-calendars
plugins.description: Look up a church season, a Hebrew date or an upcoming holy day, and put observances from both calendars on the same civil timeline.

plugins.name: coastal-conditions
plugins.description: Pair NOAA tide predictions with the latest buoy readings for a beach, inlet, or harbor.

plugins.name: night-sky
plugins.description: Plan a night outside around visible planets, moonlight, astronomical darkness, and the aurora outlook.

plugins.name: earthquake-watch
plugins.description: Find recent USGS earthquakes near a place and unpack the event record behind a headline or felt report.

plugins.name: rv-roadside
plugins.description: Find US RV repair, parts, or campgrounds and identify the right manual or component information to bring to the shop.

plugins.name: food-recall-check
plugins.description: Match product labels, lot codes, and distribution details against FDA food recall enforcement reports.

plugins.name: federal-rules-watch
plugins.description: Find recent Federal Register documents, distinguish proposed and final rules, and verify comment deadlines.

plugins.name: poetry-workshop
plugins.description: Read classic poems closely and workshop the sound and sense of your own lines.

plugins.name: met-museum-explorer
plugins.description: Build a personal tour of The Met with collection records, gallery numbers and questions for close looking.

plugins.name: chess-puzzles
plugins.description: Practice chess tactics one move at a time with rated Lichess puzzles, graduated hints and a daily challenge.

plugins.name: oz-docs
plugins.description: Write and revise Markdown documents, return to them by name, and publish finished pages.

plugins.name: oz-manuscript
plugins.description: Write and revise a book chapter by chapter, keep passage notes, and check continuity across a private manuscript.

plugins.name: oz-ide
plugins.description: Work with branches, make anchored source edits, and review proposals against a versioned repository.

plugins.name: opzero-deploy
plugins.description: Publish a site, preview the result, and restore an earlier release with OpZero.
